disclaimer.note: All component values are fictional gameplay values chosen for balance and learning. They are not official NASA or manufacturer specifications.

components.name: Compact Lander Bus
components.description: Light structure with limited mounting space.

components.name: Standard Lander Bus
components.description: Balanced structure with redundant avionics.

components.name: Heavy Cargo Bus
components.description: Carries large payloads and rovers.

components.name: Bipropellant Engine
components.description: Reliable thrust for orbit insertion and descent.

components.name: Throttleable Landing Engine
components.description: Precise thrust control for rough crater terrain.

components.name: Electric Propulsion Module
components.description: Very efficient cruise thrust, high power draw.

components.name: Standard Solar Array
components.description: Flight-proven panels. No output during lunar night.

components.name: High-Efficiency Solar Array
components.description: More output, more mass and cost.

components.name: Radioisotope Power System
components.description: Continuous power through the lunar night.

components.name: Li-ion Battery Pack
components.description: Light and affordable energy storage.

components.name: High-Capacity Li-ion Pack
components.description: More storage per unit, heavier.

components.name: Regenerative Fuel Cell
components.description: Large storage capacity, more complex.

components.name: S-band Relay Link
components.description: Low data rate, low power.

components.name: X-band Relay Link
components.description: Higher data rate for large science volumes.

components.name: Optical Comms Terminal
components.description: Very high bandwidth, newer technology.

components.name: Dipole Antenna Array
components.description: Simple, deployable radio antennas.

components.name: Crater Wire-Mesh Reflector
components.description: Large collecting area, complex deployment.

components.name: Low-Frequency Receiver Suite
components.description: Processes antenna signals into science data.

components.name: Legged Landing Gear
components.description: Shock-absorbing legs for uneven ground.

components.name: Crushable Landing Pads
components.description: Simple and light, less tolerant of slopes.

components.name: Hazard Detection & Avoidance
components.description: Sensors that steer away from boulders and craters.

components.name: Multi-Layer Insulation
components.description: Light and cheap, limited night survival.

components.name: Active Heater System
components.description: Keeps electronics warm, high power demand.

components.name: Radioisotope Heater Units
components.description: Heat without electrical power.

components.name: Deployable Radiator Panels
components.description: Rejects excess heat during the lunar day.

components.name: Deployment Rover
components.description: Drives across the crater to anchor antenna wires.

components.name: Tethered Anchor Winch
components.description: Tensions the antenna mesh from the crater rim.

components.name: Robotic Manipulator Arm
components.description: Unpacks and positions hardware near the lander.
